messages:
Jamie (runtime): Starting a thread — sketching a per-route SLO drilldown card for Console. Goal: token-level latency decomposition + throughput + error rate + regression alerts. Need inputs on metric names, tags, and alert thresholds.

Maria (eng-platform): +1. We want the canonical metric set so Console can auto-generate the card for any route. Can you list exact metric keys and tag keys rather than prose?

Jamie (runtime): Proposed metrics (flat list):
- route.name
- model.variant
- kernel.name
- sequence.length
- quantization.profile
- batch.size
- kv.cache.hit (bool)
- kv.lookup.ms
- prefix.cache.hits
- tokens.generated
- token.decode.ms
- token.kernel_exec.ms
- token.batch_wait.ms
- token.total.ms
- request.errors
- request.count

Also histograms for token.total.ms (p50/p95/p99) and per-token counters for token-stage cumulative sums so Console can render waterfall breakdowns per percentile.

Ravi (eng-ml): Add tags: kernel.variant and quantized flag. Also record kv.cache.slot (small int) so we can correlate bad cache shards.

Ian (sre): For alerting suggestions: p95 token.total.ms > 40ms for 5m OR p99 > 120ms -> page. Error rate > 0.5% for 10m -> page. Also a regression detector: compare today's p95 vs baseline (7d) and alert if > 30% relative increase.

Olivia (devops): We need token-cost attribution as well (gpu_ms_per_token, host_cpu_ms). Console card should show cost per 1k tokens and delta vs previous deploy.

Maria (eng-platform): UI notes: Console will show a per-route summary row (p50/p95/p99, rps, error%) and a per-route drilldown. Drilldown tabs: Overview, Token Waterfall (percentile slices), KV Cache heatmap (shards x hit-rate), Kernel breakdown (time by kernel.name), Recent traces (sampled logs).

Jamie (runtime): Implementation plan:
1) Runtime: emit metrics at token granularity and as aggregated histograms. Metric key examples:
   - metric: route.token.total_ms.histogram tags: route, model_variant, kernel, quantized, seq_len_bucket, batch_size
   - metric: route.token.stage_ms counter/gauge with stage=decode|kv|kernel|wait
   - metric: route.kv.hit_count / route.kv.lookup_ms tags: route, kv_shard

2) Eng-platform: wire these metrics into Console card generator and provide an API to request percentile slices and waterfall decomposition.
3) SRE: add the alerts Ian suggested and a regression detector job.

Snippet for emitting (pseudo):
```
metrics.histogram('route.token.total_ms', token_ms, tags={route, model, kernel, seq_len, quantized})
metrics.count('route.token.stage_ms', stage_ms, tags={stage, route, kernel})
metrics.count('route.kv.hits', 1, tags={route, kv_shard})
```

Maria (eng-platform): For backwards compatibility, if older runtime doesn't emit kernel tag we'll treat kernel=unknown and still show aggregated cards.

Ian (sre): Also add a short-lived trace span that includes token-level labels so we can sample full waterfall for high-p95 requests. Keep sampling at ~1/1000 by default.

Ravi (eng-ml): We should gate new tags under a feature flag so we don't spike metrics bill on day one. Also provide a config to bucket sequence lengths (e.g., 1-32,33-128,129-512,>512).

Jamie (runtime): I'll draft an RFC this week with exact metric names and example dashboards. Maria, can you scope the Console work? Ian, can you add the alerting playbook? Ravi, please add the tag plan and gating. Olivia, can you estimate cost telemetry delta?

Maria (eng-platform): Yup — I'll add a card prototype in the Console repo and ping here when ready. :thumbsup:
